name: GSK4532990
sort_evidence: GSK4532990 is ARO-HSD, the HSD17B13 siRNA licensed from Arrowhead in 2021 with no INN found, in phase 2 for alcohol-related liver disease (NCT06613698, recruiting) and MASH (NCT05583344), and the book holds no row for it (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ARO-HSD).

A Study to Investigate the Safety and Efficacy of GSK4532990 Compared With Placebo in Adult Participants Aged 18 to 70 Years With Alcohol-related Liver Disease
